annotation.title_clean: Illegal Electronic Investments in Trade Robot Missions According to the Criminal Law in Indonesia
annotation.title_en: Illegal Electronic Investments in Trade Robot Missions According to the Criminal Law in Indonesia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Samosir, G.; Danil, E.; Yunara, E.; Marlina
annotation.venue: 4th International Conference on Law Reform (INCLAR), KnE Social Sciences
named_instruments_referenced: Indonesia ITE Law (Law 11/2008, amended by Law 19/2016)
annotation.summary_en: Normative legal paper on illegal investment schemes run under the guise of software trading robots in Indonesia. It finds that Criminal Code Article 378, the ITE Law and the Investment Law leave gaps, and it calls for clearer rules on criminal liability, including corporate liability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Investment Law 25/2007 has no criminal sanctions for tech-enabled investment fraud.
Criminal Code Art. 378 fraud elements are not fully met in trading-robot scams.
ITE Law Art. 28(1) covers only electronic transactions, not investments.
Corporate criminal liability and victim compensation need special arrangements.
Specific regulation of trading robots is needed.
